providers.reason: Texas Instruments is seeing a fundamental inflection driven by AI data center power management and a recovery in automotive demand. While trading at a premium, its 23rd consecutive dividend increase and strategic 300mm fab cost advantages provide a solid floor for a technical long position ahead of earnings.
providers.risk: Cyclical weakness in the broader industrial segment and potential revenue misses if the automotive recovery stalls.

providers.reason: UBS reiterated a Buy with a $380 target, modeling Q3 revenue/EPS near the upper end of guidance, and shares rose 2.2% to $287.85 on Oct. 13. Pre-earnings drift into the Oct. 21 report, supported by the bullish preview, favors a long over the coming sessions.
providers.risk: Q3 earnings on Oct. 21 fall inside the 2-5 day horizon, creating binary event risk; weak analog-sector sentiment and recent ETF selling could sharpen a negative reaction to guidance.

providers.reason: Earnings October 21 within trading window. Up 68% YTD with data center revenue growing 90% in Q1 2026. Breaking out of long-term trading range with analyst consensus target $298-$322 offering upside from current $284 levels.
providers.risk: Extended after 68% YTD gain with elevated P/E of 43.81. High beta (1.59) amplifies market volatility risk around CPI release and earnings expectations.
